name: mcp-apps-cli-helper
description: Headless host for mcp-apps-cli: runs MCP App views in Chrome via AppBridge and turns them into terminal text frames

scripts.build: bun build host/host.ts --target browser --format iife --banner "var __require = function (m) { throw new Error('require is not available: ' + m); };" --outfile host/host.js
